name: sokola-os
description: SOKOLA OS: a modular-monolith operating system for training organizations
comment: Deliberately NOT an npm workspace root. apps/web carries its own package-lock.json and CI installs it standalone (npm ci in apps/web, cached on apps/web/package-lock.json); declaring it a workspace member makes that same npm ci resolve up to this directory instead, which is how the Cypress binary went missing in CI. The API is Python and has no package.json at all. These scripts are thin wrappers over the real harnesses and never become a second source of truth.

scripts.verify: npm run verify:spec && npm run verify:api && npm run typecheck:web && npm run build:web
